name.ja: セインティック・クルセイド

requirement.en: When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, shuffle 1 Cyberse Type monster and 1 non-Cyberse Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.

effect.en: Choose up to 2 face-up monsters on your field, and they gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you chose a WIND Attribute Cyberse Type Fusion Monster by this effect, you can destroy 1 face-up card on your opponent's field.
